lines.quote: Designed beamforming weight calculations for a 32-element UHF antenna array used in the ground-station receiver chain
Implemented a matched-filter pulse compression algorithm in C on a TI TMS320C6678 DSP, achieving 15 dB processing gain on chirp returns at 50 MSPS input rate.

Developed and maintained production Python code for the data ingestion pipeline, processing approximately 500 GB of baseband data per day through automated quality checks and format conversion routines
RF measurement: S-band antenna VSWR and gain characterisation using Rohde & Schwarz ZNB40 vector network analyser, performed during ground-station receive chain commissioning (2021)

Implemented an extended Kalman filter in the antenna tracking subsystem for automated pointing, fusing position update data with Doppler-shift measurements to maintain sub-0.1-degree pointing error during low-elevation passes.

lines.quote: In 2021 I presented a paper at the SESE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium on real-time calibration correction techniques for wideband receive arrays, co-authored with my supervisor at Hallaharju Space Systems.
Project participation required Finnish citizenship and EU national status, both of which I hold.
All of my professional work at Hallaharju Space Systems is conducted in English.
